task_text: Clear the blocker, recover and bank into the goal: A square puck slides toward the robot over an almost frictionless table at the start. Strike it with the paddle so that it hits a sliding blocker bar that obstructs the way to the goal and pushes it aside along its rail; let the puck come back toward the robot, strike it a second time, and make it bank off the long side rail and then cross the goal line while the blocker is still pushed aside. Phases, in order: first_strike: the puck touches the paddle.; clear_blocker: during this phase the puck hits the blocker (puck-blocker contact), and the blocker is displaced more than 0.065 m along its rail from its start (joint position q > 0.065 m); the phase completes at the first step at which the hit has happened and the displacement exceeds 0.065 m.; recover_deflection: the puck's centre is at world x < 0.16 m (back on the robot's side) while the puck is not touching the paddle.; second_strike: the puck touches the paddle again.; bank_and_goal: after the second strike the puck touches the bank rail at least once, and afterwards its centre crosses the goal line, world x = 0.46 m, moving in +x (x <= 0.46 on one physics step and > 0.46 on the next) with |y - 0.06| < 0.055 m (y between 0.005 and 0.115 m), while it is not touching the paddle and the blocker is still displaced more than 0.065 m. This completes the task. A crossing of that segment in this phase without a bank-rail contact since the second strike, or while touching the paddle, or with the blocker at q <= 0.065 m fails the task (skipped_route). Goal geometry: Goal line: world x = 0.46 m for 0.005 m < y < 0.115 m (centre (0.46, 0.06), half-width 0.055 m), to be crossed in +x. Recover line: puck centre at world x < 0.16 m (recover_deflection).
